Sandpoint

⚔ Inns & Taverns

#18
Cracktooth's Tavern
Tavern · Level 3
50 Raven Street
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueParlorRestaurantVenue
Popular with patrons of the nearby theater. Jesk encourages anyone and everyone to take to the stage — open-mic nights are a regular fixture.
Wares: Director's Choice (sweet blackberry wine), drunkfish vittles, Tooth Cracker rum, Understudy cheap ale
Jesk "Cracktooth" Berinni
Male human tavernkeeper — Jovial and theatrical. Loves a crowd.
#42
The Feedbag
Tavern · Level 5
10 Salmon Street
Bunyip ClubCriminalParlorRestaurant
Sandpoint's most notorious tavern — dubious food, plentiful brawls, and a popular hangout for those associated with the Bunyip Club. Jubrayl Vhiski can often be found holding court here.
Wares: Cheese curd soup, Foamer's Gulp ale, lard fries, Old Murdermaw stout
Jubrayl Vhiski
Male human rogue — Leader of the Bunyip Club, Sandpoint's organized criminal element. Charming and dangerous.
#33
The Hagfish
Tavern · Level 4
70 Water Street
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueParlorRestaurant
One of Sandpoint's most popular taverns. Jargie promotes the chance to earn your name on the ceiling beam — all you have to do is down a mug of slimy water from the tank of his pet hagfish, Norah. Tall tale competitions ("yarning") are also a fixture.
Wares: Crab 'n' Clam chowder, Jargie's Reserve rum, lingcod pot pie, Hag's Challenge drink
Jargie Quinn
Male human tavern keeper — Gregarious storyteller and promoter of local legend.
#28
Mvashti's Place
Hostel & Waystation · Level 5
50 Festival Street
TownsfolkHousingLodgeMunicipal
Once home to a beloved ancient named Niska Mvashti, this building now serves as a hostel and waystation for traveling Varisians. The current keeper ensures travelers have a comfortable stay — but is quick to remove anyone disrespecting Varisian tradition.
Wares: Lodging (floor space or bed — no private rooms), spellcasting services
Jiolan Verneeth
Agender human witch — A steadfast guardian of Varisian travelers and cultural traditions.
#13
Risa's Place
Tavern & Restaurant · Level 3
100 Undercliff Way
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueEmployerRestaurant
Named for its recently departed founder, Lanalee has taken up her mother's role with pride — keeping the family tradition of magically-enhanced repasts alive.
Wares: Huckleberry tarts, "peppers 'n' pig" skewers, spiced potatoes, Turandarok Reserve cider (chilled via ray of frost)
Lanalee Magravi
Female human sorcerer — New to running the family business, but rising to the occasion warmly.
#37
The Rusty Dragon
Inn & Tavern · Level 5
80 Market Street
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueHousingRestaurantVenueParlor
Sandpoint's most famous inn and tavern. Once run by the legendary Ameiko Kaijitsu before she departed to become Empress of Minkai, it is now lovingly managed by her longtime friend and employee.
Wares: Lodging, cheese blossoms, curried salmon, raspberry mead, barbecued abalone, seasonal ales, festival banquets
Bethana Corwin
Female halfling innkeeper — Warm, skilled, and fiercely dedicated to the Rusty Dragon's legendary reputation.
#39
Two Knight Brewery
Brewery · Level 4
20 Market Street
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueMerchant
Many of Sandpoint's taverns proudly serve alcohol brewed here. After a personal tragedy years ago, the surviving founder struggled to rekindle his passion — but today his creations are favorites of discerning connoisseurs across western Avistan.
Wares: Old Murdermaw stout, raspberry mead, Tooth Cracker rum, Turandarok Reserve cider, and many seasonal offerings
Gaven Deverin
Male human paladin — Quiet and reflective. Found healing through his craft.
#3
The White Deer
Inn & Tavern · Level 4
150 Church Street
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueHousingRestaurant
One of Sandpoint's tallest buildings at three stories. More spacious than the Rusty Dragon, though Garridan's gruff manner and plain decor make it somewhat less popular.
Wares: Lodging, pepper-crusted venison, seasonal drinks, the famous "big pork pie" (feeds four), weedwraps
Garridan Viskalai
Male human innkeeper — Gruff but reliable. Runs a clean establishment.

⚔ Shops & Services

#17
Bottled Solutions
Alchemical Shop · Level 3
60 Raven Street
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueMerchantWorkshop
For those wanting a less shady alchemical source. Legitimate, but locals whisper that Nisk's work is sometimes inconsistent. Caveat emptor.
Wares: Alchemical items & supplies, potions
Nisk Tander
Male half-elf alchemist — Well-meaning but known around town for occasionally sloppy work.
#8
Brodert's House
Sage & Library · Level 7
130 Tower Street
RunewatchersLibraryResidence
Home of one of Sandpoint's oldest and sharpest residents. Brodert is considered the greatest authority on the Lost Coast for all matters Thassilonian — and he's happy to tell you so.
Wares: Sage advice & research
Brodert Quink
Male human sage — Elderly but sharp, with an enormous personal library. A font of ancient lore.
#22
The Curious Goblin
Bookshop · Level 5
40 Main Street
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueMerchantParlor
A cozy, well-stocked bookstore with a wide range of fiction and local history. Chask often hosts impromptu gatherings for locals to chat, debate, and share knowledge.
Wares: Books (fiction & local history), scrolls, spellcasting services
Chask Haladan
Male human bard — Enthusiastic host and reader. A natural connector of ideas and people.
#44
The Feathered Serpent
Curio Shop · Level 5
10 Rum Street
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueMerchant
The best place in Sandpoint to find something unusual — or to sell something you've found. Vorvashali has an almost supernatural knack for understanding how magic items work.
Wares: Adventuring gear, curiosities, artwork, windup toys, magic items, spellcasting services
Vorvashali Voon
Male human shopkeeper — Friendly, gregarious, and remarkably knowledgeable about magical objects.
#26
General Store
Shop · Level 5
30 Main Street
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueMerchant
The oldest shop in town, providing all the staples you'd need at affordable prices. Ven takes enormous pride in the store's long history.
Wares: General goods, groceries, imported alcohol (5 sp–5 gp/bottle)
Ven Vinder
Male human grocer — A proud proprietor of Sandpoint's oldest commercial establishment.
#38
Goblin Squash Stables
Stables · Level 4
60 Market Street
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueMerchant
Sandpoint's largest stables. Daviren's well-known hatred of goblins has increasingly divided opinion in town.
Wares: Stabling
Daviren Hosk
Male human ranger — Capable stablemaster with strong (and vocal) opinions about goblins.
#9
Locksmith
Shop · Level 4
90 Tower Street
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueMerchantWorkshop
One of Sandpoint's longest-lived residents. Volioker has never succumbed to threat or bribery from local criminals — a point of considerable personal pride.
Wares: Locks & locksmithing services
Volioker Briskalberd
Male dwarf locksmith — Straightforward and incorruptible.
#16
The Pillbug's Pantry
Alchemical Shop · Level 6
100 Tanglefoot Alley
Bunyip ClubCriminalMerchantWorkshop
Hidden at the end of Tanglefoot Alley, this cluttered shop sells plenty of legal supplies — but its open trade in poisons and other illegal alchemical wares is one of Sandpoint's worst-kept secrets.
Wares: Alchemical items & supplies, poisons, potions
Aliver "Pillbug" Podiker
Male human alchemist — Earned his nickname as a child for reasons he's never quite admitted.
#15
Red Dog Smithy
Smithy · Level 4
190 Festival Street
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueMerchantWorkshop
Named for the owner's affection for large red mastiffs. Known as much for Das's exceptional smithwork as for his legendary temper.
Wares: Smithing services
Das Korvut
Male human fighter — Brilliant smith, legendary temper. Approach with patience.
#5
Rings and Things
Jeweler & Moneylender · Level 3
10 Church Street
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueMerchant
A jewelry store that doubles as a moneylending service. Maver keeps a half-dozen tough locals on hand as guards, quietly suggesting the value of the stock within.
Wares: Jewelry & art objects (5 sp–10 gp), moneylending
Maver Kesk
Male human jeweler — Careful and businesslike.
#14
Rovanky Tannery
Tannery & Shop · Level 3
10 Undercliff Way
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueMerchantWorkshop
High-quality leather goods — expect a wait for custom orders, as Larz is something of a perfectionist.
Wares: Leather goods (custom orders available)
Larz Rovanky
Male human leatherworker — Meticulous craftsman; not easily rushed.
#41
Sandpoint Boutique
General Shop · Level 4
90 Market Street
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueMerchant
One never knows what unexpected surprises might turn up at the Boutique. Hayliss frequently travels to restock and maintains a wide network of adventuring contacts.
Wares: Equipment, clothing, weapons, tools, art objects, spellcasting services
Hayliss Korvaski
Female human cleric of Abadar — Sharp businesswoman with an adventurer's network and a nose for interesting stock.
#36
Sandpoint Meat Market
Butcher · Level 3
120 Market Street
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueMerchant
A butcher shop and slaughterhouse combined. Chod has a penchant for exaggeration and rumormongering — take what he says with a grain of salt.
Wares: Meat
Chod Bevuk
Male human butcher — A talker who loves to gossip. Useful for local rumors, though reliability varies.
#21
Sandpoint Savories
Bakery · Level 5
90 Main Street
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueMerchant
It's not just the tantalizing smells wafting from this bakery six mornings a week that make it a local favorite — Alma's passion and skill show in every bite. Townspeople gossip about her daughter Arika, who recently left to become an adventurer.
Wares: Pastries, cookies, and baked goods (at 75% normal price)
Alma Avertin
Female human baker — A beloved fixture of Sandpoint's mornings. Bakes with genuine love.
#12
Savah's Armory
Weapon & Armor Shop · Level 4
20 Tower Street
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueMerchant
Sandpoint's largest weapon and armor shop. The owner is caught between delight at the uptick in adventuring business and a quiet unease about why so many adventurers seem to be needed lately.
Wares: Armor, shields, weapons, ammunition, runes
Savah Bevaniky
Female human fighter — Capable and knowledgeable. A fair dealer who knows her stock intimately.
#34
Valdemar Fish Market
Fish Market · Level 5
10 Water Street
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueMerchant
Seafood is a mainstay of many Sandpoint tables. Though getting on in years, Turch's devotion to keeping the market well stocked is commendable.
Wares: Fish & seafood
Turch Sterglus
Male human fisher — A Sandpoint institution. Old, steady, and reliable.
#30
Vernah's Fine Clothing
Clothier · Level 5
70 Prickleback Lane
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueMerchant
A mix of down-home rustic options and fancier outfits for nights on the town. Something for shoppers of every nature.
Wares: Clothing, nonmetallic light armor
Rynshinn Povalli
Female half-elf tailor — Thoughtful and skilled. Makes everyone feel like they've found the right outfit.
#4
The Way North
Map Shop · Level 4
140 Cliff Street
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueLibraryMerchant
A specialized shop offering a staggering range of maps — from detailed regional surveys to novelty treasure maps.
Wares: Regional & novelty maps (5 sp–10 gp), spellcasting services
Veznutt Parooh
Male gnome wizard — Enthusiastic cartographer with a passion for obscure routes and forgotten places.

Wheen's Wagons
Wagon Shop · Level 3
30 River Street
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueMerchant
Trying to turn around a struggling business, Bilivar added a home-grown courier service — though so far it's done little to change his luck.
Wares: Wagons, wheel repairs, courier service
Bilivar Wheen
Male human wheelwright — Down on his luck but still trying. A decent fellow in a hard spot.

⚔ Faith & Worship

#45
Hannah's
Herbalist & Healer · Level 4
30 Hook Street
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueMerchantMunicipal
While the cathedral does its best to serve all, Hannah helps carry the load — particularly for the women of Sandpoint. She is widely considered one of the town's most beloved figures.
Wares: Restorative & medicinal alchemical supplies, spellcasting services
Hannah Velerin
Female elf cleric of Gozreh — Kindly, patient, and deeply committed to the community's wellbeing.
#19
House of Blue Stones
Monastery · Level 4
30 Glass Street
Town WatchLibraryTemple
A stone building whose floor is decorated with blue stones, helping visitors find meditative peace. Jabyl also keeps a growing library of old books and scrolls in the basement — not granted to just anyone.
Jabyl Sorn
Female human monk — Serene and discerning. Values knowledge and knows how to protect it.
#2
Sandpoint Boneyard
Cemetery · Level 3
60 Church Street
Sandpoint CathedralEmployerMerchant
The town's official graveyard, carefully tended by its caretaker. Spellcasting services are offered to those who need them.
Wares: Spellcasting services
Naffer Vosk
Male human cleric of Sarenrae — Gravedigger & caretaker. Quiet and thoughtful; devoted to his work.
#1
Sandpoint Cathedral
Temple · Level 5
60 Church Street
Sandpoint CathedralTempleMerchantMunicipal
The largest building in Sandpoint — a grand multidenominational cathedral with shrines to Abadar, Calistria, Desna, Erastil, Gozreh, Sarenrae, and Shelyn. Worshippers of all non-evil faiths are welcome.
Wares: Healing magic, religious items, +1 favored weapons (crossbow, starknife, longbow, trident, scimitar, glaive), divine scrolls, spellcasting services
Abstalar Zantus
Male human cleric of Desna — High Priest. Warm and welcoming; the spiritual heart of Sandpoint.

⚔ Civic & Government

#43
The Pixie's Kitten
Brothel · Level 4
60 Salmon Street
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueHousingParlor
Run with style and grace. Employees are well cared for and protected by Kaye's sorcerous talents, a trio of capable guards, and the open secret of Kaye's marriage to the town sheriff.
Kaye Tesarani
Female human rogue — Sharp, protective, and surprisingly politically connected. Married to Sheriff Hemlock.
#10
Sandpoint Garrison
Barracks & Jail · Level 5
210 Main Street
Town WatchGarrisonMunicipal
The town's jail and guard barracks, recently reconstructed. Belor Hemlock has served as Sandpoint's sheriff for nearly two decades and shows no signs of retiring anytime soon.
Belor Hemlock
Male human sheriff — Calm, firm, experienced. Has seen Sandpoint through its worst days and remains its steady guardian.
#35
Sandpoint Market
Marketplace · Level 5
Junction of Festival, Market & Water Streets
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueMerchantParlorVenue
Empty most days, but twice a week this marketplace fills with vendors. The farmers' market runs every Moonday; the town market every Fireday draws traveling merchants from throughout western Varisia.
Wares: General goods & food (market days only)
#40
Sandpoint Mercantile League
League Hall · Level 4
110 Market Street
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueMerchant
Here one can arrange ship passage, overland caravan travel, send messages, ship goods, or shop for property along the Lost Coast. Jasper recently married his longtime love, Cyrdak Drokkus, in what townsfolk described as a very long time coming.
Wares: Caravan passage, messenger service, property sales, shipping services
Jasper Korvaski
Male human paladin — Day-to-day head of the League. Steady, reliable, and recently much happier.
#23
Sandpoint Theater
Theater · Level 6
90 Festival Street
RunewatchersVenueParlor
The pride and joy of local thespian Cyrdak Drokkus — an unusually grand theater for a town of Sandpoint's size. Cyrdak is always on the hunt for the next big star. Rumors fly about his next big production.
Wares: Pauper's Pit (1 cp), general seating (1 sp), balcony seating with refreshments (1 gp)
Cyrdak Drokkus
Male human bard — Flamboyant, witty, and infectiously enthusiastic about the dramatic arts.
#11
Sandpoint Town Hall
Courthouse · Level 5
140 Main Street
TownsfolkMunicipal
The political heart of Sandpoint, where all important town meetings take place. Its clerk has increasingly become the hall's primary day-to-day attendant.
Shayliss Vinder
Genderfluid human clerk — Diligent and increasingly indispensable to the hall's operations.
#27
Turandarok Academy
School & Orphanage · Level 6
10 Main Street
RunewatchersLibraryMunicipal
Primarily a local orphanage, and secondarily a school. The headmaster also offers spellcasting services to those who can afford them.
Wares: Spellcasting services
Ilsoari Gandethus
Male human wizard — Headmaster. Caring toward his charges; a knowledgeable mage outside the classroom.

⚔ Guilds & Industry

#24
Carpenter's Guild
Guildhall · Level 5
60 Festival Street
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueWorkshopMerchant
Most of Sandpoint's buildings were raised by members of this guild. Aesrick is always eager for a new challenge, though the long-running feud with the local shipyard continues to gnaw at him.
Wares: Carpentry services
Aesrick Battlehorn
Male dwarf carpenter — Guild leader. Proud of his craft and his guild's history in building the town.
#29
Grocer's Hall
Guildhall · Level 4
20 Festival Street
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueEmployerMerchant
The open-air building where many local farmers come to trade their produce. The guildmaster is now one of Sandpoint's most beloved institutions — local children especially adore his Sunday candy-grab tradition.
Wares: Standard food & drink, farming supplies
Olmur Danavakus
Male halfling grocer — Guildmaster. Warm, community-minded, with a legendary soft spot for children.
#25
Sandpoint Lumber Mill
Lumber Mill · Level 3
120 River Street
Scarnetti ConsortiumEmployer
Not long after a goblin raid 17 years ago, a grisly murder took place here. The manager has largely recovered from the shock, but still has nightmares — and rumors persist of a haunt within the mill.
Ibor Thorn
Male human logger — Quiet and haunted by past events. Does his job without complaint.
#46
Sandpoint Shipyard
Guildhall · Level 4
10 Hook Street
Sandpoint Mercantile LeagueWorkshopMerchant
Modest by city standards but significant for a town of Sandpoint's size. Jhalevia is foul-mouthed but fair, well-loved by the community despite still feeling slightly like an outsider after several years in town.
Wares: Ships, shipbuilding services, sea passage to other ports
Jhalevia Stensin
Female human harbormaster — From Thuvia. Beloved for her creativity with curses and her skill managing the yard.
#32
Scarnetti Mill
Grain Mill · Level 3
40 River Street
Scarnetti ConsortiumEmployer
This mill processes all of the flour and grain produced by local farmers. The manager struggles to make ends meet, even as the mill turns a tidy profit for its owners, the Scarnettis.
Courrin Whesterwill
Male human miller — Conscientious and weary. Does his best with what little he's given.

⚔ Manors & Estates

#50
Deverin Manor
Manor · Level 6
40 Schooner Gulch Road
TownsfolkMunicipalResidence
Home of Sandpoint's mayor and her extended family, including her brother, sister-in-law, and five nephews. Kendra has eagerly embraced the town's multi-faction political landscape, finding distributed power has served Sandpoint well — if at considerably more work.
Mayor Kendra Deverin
Female human mayor — Capable, civic-minded, and well-loved. The steady hand guiding Sandpoint's government.
#49
Kaijitsu Manor
Manor · Level 5
35 Schooner Gulch Road
TownsfolkMunicipalResidence
When Ameiko Kaijitsu departed to become Empress of Minkai, she left the manor in capable hands so it would be ready for her return visits. The caretakers maintain it lovingly in her name.
Velarie Neserin
Female human majordomo — Dedicated steward of the Kaijitsu legacy. Her reputation in Sandpoint carries genuine political weight.
#48
Scarnetti Manor
Manor · Level 4
25 Schooner Gulch Road
Scarnetti ConsortiumMunicipalResidence
Home of one of Sandpoint's founding families. Titus has long enjoyed his family's position of power, and is somewhat bitter about having to actively earn it now. He shares the sprawling manor with his wife, children, his aunt, and a small army of servants.
Titus Scarnetti
Male human aristocrat — Proud, politically ambitious, and not particularly warm to outsiders.
#47
Valdemar Manor
Abandoned Manor · Level 1
30 Schooner Gulch Road
Hazard
Once the home of one of Sandpoint's founding families, the manor is now boarded up and slowly falling into ruin. Kaleb, the only surviving son, visits occasionally to handle family affairs — but stays at an inn when he does.
Kaleb Valdemar
Male human wizard — Visits infrequently. Reluctant to return to the old manor. Most expect he'll sell eventually.

⚔ Hazards & Rough Places

#7
Gorvi's Shack
Residence · Level 3
140 Tower Street
Bunyip ClubCriminalResidence
The town's sanitation falls to Gorvi, an unpleasant man who maintains an unpleasant group of youths for an unpleasant but vital job. It's said the value of their services lets them get away with more than one might expect.
Gorvi
Male half-orc — Town cleaner. Difficult to deal with, but handles work nobody else wants.
#6
Junker's Edge
Town Dump · Level 3
West end of Junker's Way
Hazard
Sandpoint's dump — little more than a cliffside where refuse collects on the beach below. Theoretically washed out by the tide, in practice the trash accumulates and attracts dangerous scavengers.
#20
Sandpoint Glassworks
Ruin · Level 5
10 Glass Street
Hazard
Once one of Sandpoint's most valuable industries, the glassworks are now abandoned and widely presumed to be haunted.

Seven Dooms for Sandpoint — Player Reference

History of Sandpoint

Current Year: AR 4724
A Chronicle of the Light of the Lost Coast
What follows is a record of Sandpoint's past as known to its citizens — the triumphs, tragedies, and turning points that shaped the town into what it is today.
Ancient History
Prehistory
Before AR 1
The Thassilonian Empire
Long before Sandpoint existed, the Lost Coast was part of the ancient empire of Thassilon — a realm of towering monuments, powerful runelords, and forgotten magic. The ruins scattered across the region, including fragments buried beneath the surrounding hills, are remnants of this lost civilization. Scholars warn that Thassilonian magic does not always stay buried.
Founding Era
Founding
AR 4666
Sandpoint Is Founded
Four noble families — the Deverins, Kaijitsus, Scarnettis, and Valdemars — pool their resources to establish a permanent settlement on the Lost Coast. They form the Sandpoint Mercantile League, dividing the town's commerce among themselves. The natural harbor, fertile surroundings, and proximity to Magnimar make it an attractive venture. The town grows steadily over the following decades.
Conflict
AR 4666
The Varisian Conflict
The Mercantile League's expansion brings them into conflict with a Varisian tribe that has wintered on these lands for generations. Negotiations stall. Alamon Scarnetti — acting without sanction — leads a drunken raid on their camp, leaving dead on both sides. The Varisian Council of Magnimar intervenes. Through the diplomacy of Almah Deverin, a compromise is reached: the Varisians waive their claim to the land in exchange for forty years of profit-sharing from Sandpoint's commerce, an agreement set to expire in AR 4726.
The Late Unpleasantness
Crime
AR 4702
The Chopper
Over the course of a single winter, Sandpoint is terrorized by a serial killer the townsfolk come to call "The Chopper." Bodies are found every few days — victims bearing savage wounds and missing hands, feet, eyes, and tongue. Sheriff Casp Avertin confronts the killer in what becomes known as Chopper's Alley, mortally wounding him at the cost of his own life. His deputy, Belor Hemlock, follows the blood trail to its grim conclusion. Twenty-five victims in total. The site is sealed and burned. Hemlock is named Sheriff shortly thereafter.
Disaster
AR 4702
The Sandpoint Fire
Months after the Chopper is stopped, the Sandpoint Chapel burns to the ground. Father Tobyn, the town's beloved priest, perishes in the blaze. His adopted daughter Nualia is presumed dead as well. The loss of both the Chopper's victims and the chapel's priest within the same year leaves deep scars on the community — a period the townsfolk quietly call "The Late Unpleasantness." The chapel is eventually rebuilt as the grander Sandpoint Cathedral, consecrated years later.
Recent History
Conflict
AR 4707
The Goblin Raid
During the Swallowtail Festival — the grand consecration of the new Sandpoint Cathedral — goblins from the Thistletop tribe attack the town. The raid is fierce but ultimately repelled, largely thanks to a group of visiting adventurers who become locally celebrated heroes. The town suffers property damage and several casualties, but recovers. The goblins are not heard from again in significant numbers for some years.
Crime
AR 4707
The Skinsaw Murders
Only five years after the Chopper's reign of terror, Sandpoint suffers another string of ritual murders. Victims are found with Sihedron stars carved into their chests. The same adventurers who drove off the goblins investigate alongside Sheriff Hemlock, eventually tracing the killings to a broader conspiracy rooted in Magnimar. The crisis is resolved, though the details remain disturbing enough that most townsfolk prefer not to speak of it.
Conflict
AR 4707
The Giant Raid
Months after the Skinsaw Murders, a force of Stone Giants accompanied by a red dragon descends on Sandpoint, seizing citizens before being driven off. The town is badly shaken — the assault feels less like a raid and more like a deliberate strike. The heroes of Sandpoint pursue the giants and return the captives. The full scope of what lay behind the attack is never made entirely public.
Notable Event
AR 4712
The Licktoad Affair & Ameiko's Departure
The Licktoad goblin tribe of Brinestump Marsh begins raiding the outskirts of Sandpoint, having acquired a dangerous cache of fireworks from unknown sources. Before the situation escalates, Ameiko Kaijitsu — beloved proprietor of the Rusty Dragon — and a band of companions intervene and put an end to the threat. Shortly afterward, Ameiko sets off on a journey to Tian Xia, leaving the inn in trusted hands. She has not returned.
Disaster
AR 4713
The Tsunami
Seismic upheaval far to the south sends a great wave crashing into the Lost Coast. Sandpoint sustains significant damage and loses several of its citizens. The town rebuilds with characteristic resilience. Simultaneously, a massive sinkhole opens in the plateau east of town, exposing the upper reaches of an enormous subterranean ruin. Locals call it simply The Pit. Monsters have since claimed the area, and the town watch strongly advises against approaching.
